'''Senate Port Complex #2''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] carrying [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] was blown up a thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] Port Complex #2 while landing on Coruscant. Wren survived the attack by exiting the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in a [[Escape pod/Legends|crash pod]].<ref name="Lockdown" />
